fusions.name: Limb-Leap Ambush
fusions.desc: Leaps you from a high limb onto a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Silvervine Dust
fusions.desc: Shakes silvervine pollen over every enemy within 3 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 20% chance to turn each one on its neighbours for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Up the Trunk
fusions.desc: Scrambles you 3 tiles from where you stood and increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Ninth Life
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you standing at 1 health instead.
